name: test-shiny-app
description: Test Shiny applications using shinytest2 for end-to-end browser tests and testServer() for unit-testing module server logic. Covers snapshot testing, CI integration, and mocking external services. Use when adding tests to an existing Shiny application, setting up a testing strategy for a new Shiny project, writing regression tests before refactoring Shiny code, or integrating Shiny app tests into CI/CD pipelines.
